chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Haul Control to all couriers — the Vane Street corridor is open again. Lanes four through nine, keep it under two hundred.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: We have a manifest mismatch on the Kessel drop. If that box is warm, it is not my problem.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: PULL UP, COURIER. PULL UP. YOU ARE INSIDE THE STACK.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Shift change in ten. Whoever is on the roof at Ardent, the beacon is out again. Still.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Somebody has parked a freighter across two of my lanes. I am told this is temporary. I am told a lot of things.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Weather is closing the upper approach at Pale Terrace. If you are booked up there, you are now booked somewhere else.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Haul Control, all couriers. Vault Row has closed its low approach for the night. Come in high or come in tomorrow.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Advisory for the Ninefold Approach. The beacon is reading. The beacon is lying. Fly it by eye.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Anyone still holding for Sixteen Low, the pad has been reassigned. I would tell you to whom, but nobody told me.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Reminder to the lane. Sootfields is a corridor, not a shortcut. I can see all of you.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: We have a stalled hauler across Gantry Row. Go around it, go under it, go home. Do not go through it.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Cinder Step is stacking six deep. If your parcel is not warm, take the long way and enjoy the quiet.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: That is the third transponder failure over The Drownings this shift. If you go dark down there, nobody is coming.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Haul Control. Marrow Landing has power again. Everything standing on it does not.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Lanes four through nine are yours until the weather turns. The weather always turns.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Somebody on this band is broadcasting music. It is not good music. Please stop.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: The Spindle deck is closed to unlicensed traffic. Yes, that means you. It has always meant you.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Courier traffic, stay off Pale Terrace for the next hour. There is a thing happening and I am not being told what.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: SEPARATE. SEPARATE. TWO OF YOU ARE IN THE SAME LANE AT THE SAME HEIGHT.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Courier, your parcel is logged and the pad is holding for you. Try not to make them wait.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Logged. Clock's running. Try to look like you've done this before.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: That's on your manifest now. Whatever it is.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Confirmed. Lane's clear as far as I can see, which is not far.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: You've got it. Sealed, weighed, and none of my business.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Accepted. They asked for someone reliable. I sent you anyway.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Booked. Take the high lane, the low one's a car park.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: On the board and off my desk. Go.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Logged. The pad knows you are coming. It is not excited about it.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: You have it. The weight is declared, which is not the same as true.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Confirmed. Straight there, and I do mean straight.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: On your manifest. Try to arrive with the same number of pieces.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Booked. If it rattles, that is normal. If it stops rattling, hurry.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Accepted. The client is already asking where you are. They asked before you took it.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: That is yours. I have put you down as reliable, which was a decision.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Sealed and signed. Do not open it, do not shake it, do not ask.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Logged at this end. The clock started before I finished saying that.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Got it. Lane is busy, weather is turning, and you said yes anyway.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Confirmed. Somebody wanted this yesterday, so today is already late.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: You are on it. Nice and boring, please. Boring is the good one.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Nice run. Credits are clearing now. Don't spend it all in the Ribs.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Signed for. Money's moving. Slowly, but it's moving.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Delivered and closed. That's one thing today that went where it was supposed to.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Paid. They didn't complain, which from them is a compliment.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Clean drop. I'm marking you as competent. Don't make me change it.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Received in one piece. Credits inbound. Enjoy the four minutes before you need them.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Logged, paid, forgotten. That's the job.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Done. There's more where that came from, unfortunately.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Delivered. The credits are moving through four systems that all take a cut. What is left is yours.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Signed for. They counted it twice in front of you, which is their way of being friendly.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Paid. Nothing broken, nothing missing, nobody shouting. Rare.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Closed. That parcel is somebody else's problem now, and honestly it always was.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Clean drop. I have had worse days, and most of them were this one.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Received. Money is in. Spend it on the cell before you spend it on anything fun.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Logged. They have asked for you specifically next time, which is either a compliment or a warning.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Done and paid. Go and sit somewhere with a roof over it for ten minutes.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: That has cleared. Small job, small money, still money.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Delivered on time, which I have noted, because nobody else will.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Paid out. There is a queue of work behind it. There always is.

chatter.speaker: HAUL CONTROL
chatter.text: Settled. And before you ask, yes, there is more.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Air Division, routine sweep, lanes one through six. Nothing to see. As usual.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Unregistered hauler in the Lantern Quarter, descending. We are aware. We are not interested.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Courier craft, you are flying a lane you are not licensed for. Consider this the friendly version.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: HOLD YOUR ALTITUDE. HOLD IT. DO NOT DESCEND.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Cargo seizure at pad nine. Owner declined to attend. Owner never does.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Break off pursuit, we lost him in the smog band. Log it as weather.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Air Division to all units. Be advised, grey hauler, no transponder, last seen crossing Tallow Yard low and fast. Do not approach it. Just tell us where it went.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: All craft in the Lantern Quarter, this is City Patrol. A vehicle on your band is running a false registry. If it hails you, do not answer it.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Notice to lane traffic. Pike Deck is a controlled approach from tonight. Fly it without clearance and we will find you. Eventually. Probably.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Air Division, routine sweep, Vault Row. Nothing. Same as last night. Same as the night before that.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Security advisory. Two craft are working the Gantry as a pair. One stops you, the other takes the cargo. If you get flagged down over the Gantry, keep flying.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: HOLD YOUR LINE. HOLD IT. YOU ARE CROSSING A CONTROLLED APPROACH.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: We have a craft parked mid lane over Ninefold with its lights off. It has been there two hours. Somebody go and look at it. Not me.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: All units, cargo theft reported at Quill Step. Description of the vehicle, a courier craft. That is the entire description we were given.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Air Division. If you are the one flying under the Sever Wall, we can see you, we have always been able to see you, and it is not clever.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Be advised, the smog band is down to sixty metres over Sootfields. If you lose somebody in there, log it as weather and go home.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Notice. An unlicensed pad is operating somewhere off Low Ferrand. We are told that it moves. Pads do not move. We are looking into it.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Patrol to control. That hauler we flagged over Marrow Landing has put itself in the water. Recovery is your problem now.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: This is City Patrol, Air Division. The Drownings is not closed. The Drownings is simply not recommended. There is a difference and it is yours.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Alert to all lanes. A craft matching the theft report was seen at Redoubt Two. It has since been seen at four other places at the same time, which tells you how good the report is.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: CLEAR THE PAD. CLEAR THE PAD. WE HAVE A CRAFT COMING IN WITHOUT POWER.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Air Division. Somebody has taken the beacon off the Kiln. Not broken it. Taken it. It weighs four hundred kilos.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Advisory for couriers. If a client meets you out on the pad instead of inside, that is not a client. Log it and fly.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: Routine notice. Speed enforcement is active on the Spine Run tonight. Enforcement means we write it down.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: We have found the craft from the Quill Step report. It was never stolen. Its owner forgot where he parked it. Three days.

chatter.speaker: CITY PATROL
chatter.text: City Patrol to all air traffic. Stand by for a controlled descent over Ashlock Upper. Anyone below three hundred metres, be somewhere else.

chatter.speaker: THE UNDERSTACK
chatter.text: You're on the understack. If you can hear me, you're too low, and that's exactly where I want you.

chatter.speaker: THE UNDERSTACK
chatter.text: They say the Pale Terrace towers are empty. Forty floors, every light on, nobody home. Ask yourself who's paying that bill.

chatter.speaker: THE UNDERSTACK
chatter.text: Couriers — if a client won't tell you what's in the box, that's not a red flag. That's a pay rise. Charge accordingly.

chatter.speaker: THE UNDERSTACK
chatter.text: THEY ARE NOT CLOUDS. THEY HAVE NEVER BEEN CLOUDS. LOOK UP.

chatter.speaker: THE UNDERSTACK
chatter.text: Anyway. Rain until Thursday. Fly low, fly rude.

chatter.speaker: THE UNDERSTACK
chatter.text: You are down in the understack. Nobody licensed this, nobody is paying for this, and nobody can find the transmitter. Yet.

chatter.speaker: THE UNDERSTACK
chatter.text: Forty floors at Pale Terrace, every light burning, nobody home. That is not a building. That is a receipt.

chatter.speaker: THE UNDERSTACK
chatter.text: Somebody asked me why the sky is grey. Wrong question. Ask who it is grey for.

chatter.speaker: THE UNDERSTACK
chatter.text: They put a new sign on the Kiln this week. Same building, same everything, new sign. That is the whole economy, right there.

chatter.speaker: THE UNDERSTACK
chatter.text: Message for the patrol craft that has been circling the Ribs for an hour. I can hear your engine through the microphone. Come in and have a cup of something.

chatter.speaker: THE UNDERSTACK
chatter.text: If you are flying low enough to hear this clearly, congratulations, you are breaking about four rules. Keep going.

chatter.speaker: THE UNDERSTACK
chatter.text: The Market is still open. They will tell you it is not. It is. Go round the back of the Gantry and follow the noise.

chatter.speaker: THE UNDERSTACK
chatter.text: Here is a fact they do not put on the boards. Nobody in this city was born in this city. Nobody. Think about who that is convenient for.

chatter.speaker: THE UNDERSTACK
chatter.text: TURN IT UP. IF YOUR NEIGHBOUR COMPLAINS, TURN IT UP AGAIN.

chatter.speaker: THE UNDERSTACK
chatter.text: Somebody has left a parcel outside the studio. I am not opening it, I am not moving it, and I am broadcasting next to it, which is a decision I am reviewing.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: Tallow Nutrient Paste. Nine flavours. All of them are paste.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: Breathing shouldn't be a luxury. At Ardent Air, breathing is a subscription. That's better.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: Kell's Rest. Sleep four hours, wake up owing nothing. Terms apply. Many terms apply.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: New from Vantage Optics — see the sky the way it used to be, for eleven credits a month, forever.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: EVERY UNIT MUST GO. EVERY UNIT. WE ARE NOT COMING BACK.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: Drownings Reclamation. We buy anything. We do not ask.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: Cinder Step Storage. Your things, somewhere else, forever, for less.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: Feeling slow? Feeling grey? That is your body asking for Bright. Bright is a drink. Bright is a choice. Bright is nine credits.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: The Gantry Market. Everything you need and eleven things you do not. Bring a light.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: Halyard Nine Clinic. Walk in with a problem. Walk out with a payment plan.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: CLOSING DOWN. CLOSING DOWN. AGAIN.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: Pike Deck Fuel. The cheapest on the approach, because we are the furthest from anywhere.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: New from Vantage Optics. The Clear filter. See the city the way the architects intended it, with none of the people in it.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: Sunder Rest Insurance. We cover everything except what happens.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: Kell's Rest Noodles. Open all night, because the night is also open.

chatter.speaker: COMMERCIAL BAND
chatter.text: Own a piece of Pale Terrace. Forty floors, one owner, and it could be you. It will not be you.

chatter.speaker: EMERGENCY BAND
chatter.text: Mayday, mayday — cell's gone, I'm at ninety metres and dropping, anyone on this band —

chatter.speaker: EMERGENCY BAND
chatter.text: I AM IN THE SMOG BAND. I CANNOT SEE THE LANE. I CANNOT SEE THE LANE.

chatter.speaker: EMERGENCY BAND
chatter.text: It's not an emergency yet. I'm just saying it might be. In about a minute.

chatter.speaker: EMERGENCY BAND
chatter.text: GET OFF THE PAD. GET OFF THE PAD NOW.

chatter.speaker: EMERGENCY BAND
chatter.text: Cancel the mayday. I found a ledge. It'll do.

chatter.speaker: EMERGENCY BAND
chatter.text: Anyone on this band, I have a cargo fire, repeat, cargo fire, I am putting it down on the first flat thing I can see.

chatter.speaker: EMERGENCY BAND
chatter.text: IT IS COMING OFF. THE WHOLE PANEL IS COMING OFF. GET CLEAR OF ME.

chatter.speaker: EMERGENCY BAND
chatter.text: This is not an emergency. I am formally declaring that it is not an emergency. Please stay on this channel anyway.

chatter.speaker: EMERGENCY BAND
chatter.text: I have lost the lane markers over Sootfields. I am flying on the instruments and the instruments have opinions.

chatter.speaker: EMERGENCY BAND
chatter.text: SOMEBODY IS IN THE WATER. SOMEBODY IS IN THE WATER OFF THE DROWNINGS.

chatter.speaker: EMERGENCY BAND
chatter.text: Cell at eight per cent. Eight. I am nine minutes from anywhere. Please tell me somebody is nearer than that.

chatter.speaker: EMERGENCY BAND
chatter.text: My passenger has stopped answering me. I do not know what to do about that at four hundred metres.

chatter.speaker: EMERGENCY BAND
chatter.text: Correction to my last. Correction. I have it back. I have it back. Stand down. Thank you. Thank you.

chatter.speaker: EMERGENCY BAND
chatter.text: Mayday relay, mayday relay. I am not the one in trouble. I am just the one who can still transmit.

chatter.speaker: ATMOSPHERIC
chatter.text: Atmospheric bulletin. Particulate density high below one hundred metres. Visibility, four hundred. Conditions are within normal.

chatter.speaker: ATMOSPHERIC
chatter.text: Precipitation across all districts for the next nine hours. Surface reflectivity elevated. Reduce approach speed.

chatter.speaker: ATMOSPHERIC
chatter.text: Daylight index, zero point two. This is the maximum for today.

chatter.speaker: ATMOSPHERIC
chatter.text: Electrical activity above three hundred metres. Craft in the upper lanes should descend. Craft that cannot descend should continue.

chatter.speaker: ATMOSPHERIC
chatter.text: The smog band has lifted to one hundred and forty metres. Enjoy the view.

chatter.speaker: ATMOSPHERIC
chatter.text: Atmospheric bulletin. Wind shear across the upper lanes above two hundred metres. Craft under six tonnes should not be up there. Craft over six tonnes are not our concern.

chatter.speaker: ATMOSPHERIC
chatter.text: Rainfall total for the period, forty one millimetres. Rainfall total for the year, unavailable. The instrument is under water.

chatter.speaker: ATMOSPHERIC
chatter.text: Bulletin. Temperature, eleven degrees. Temperature at street level, unknown. Nobody is measuring street level.

chatter.speaker: ATMOSPHERIC
chatter.text: Visibility at the Spine, two hundred metres. Visibility at Sootfields, one hundred. Visibility at the Drownings, not applicable.

chatter.speaker: ATMOSPHERIC
chatter.text: Advisory. Ice is forming on approach surfaces above three hundred and twenty metres. Descend, or accept the ice.

chatter.speaker: ATMOSPHERIC
chatter.text: Atmospheric bulletin. The particulate index has been revised. It has not improved. The index has been revised.

chatter.speaker: ATMOSPHERIC
chatter.text: Daylight index, zero point one. Sunrise occurred. Sunset will occur. Neither will be visible.

chatter.speaker: ATMOSPHERIC
chatter.text: Bulletin. A pressure front is crossing Vault Row. Expect turbulence, expect delay, expect the usual.

chatter.speaker: ATMOSPHERIC
chatter.text: Conditions are within normal. Normal has been revised twice this year.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Third time at this pad and the lift's still out. I'm carrying it up. Forty floors. Somebody owes me a drink.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Market's open on the Gantry until two. Bring your own light, the strip's been dead since spring.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Anyone flying past Sixteen Low — is that a fire or is that just Tuesday?

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Tower maintenance, block nine. We are aware the beacon is out. We have been aware for some time.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Taxi four-one-one, off shift, going home. Whoever's got the Lantern run tonight — good luck, and I mean that.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: My kid asked what the sky looks like. I said grey. She said what's grey. Fair question.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: GET IT OFF THE EDGE. OFF THE EDGE. IT IS NOT SECURED.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Understack, if you're listening — play the one about the windows again. It's been a week.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Twenty two hours on this run and I have seen the same advert for paste eleven times. Eleven. I could recite it. I will not, but I could.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: They have resurfaced the Spine Run and it is worse. I do not know how you make a lane worse, but they have found a way and they should be proud of themselves.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Does anybody know a pad that will take a nine tonner after midnight? And before you say Tallow Yard, Tallow Yard says no. Tallow Yard always says no.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Cargo is fine, I am fine, and the craft is making a noise it was not making yesterday. That is the whole report.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Four hours left, a flask of something brown, and a lane full of couriers who all think they are the only one in it.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: It says here I am carrying agricultural equipment. There is no agriculture. I have never seen a field. I am carrying something, I will give them that.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Anyone at the Bell Yard, the lift is out again. And before you ask, yes, I have told them, and yes, they have noted it.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: The tea place on Quill Run has closed. Just so everyone knows. I am still processing it.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Whoever keeps parking across the Ninefold Approach, I have your registry and I have nothing else to do.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: I have been flying this city forty years and it has never once been finished. Not once. Always scaffolding.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: My grandson says he is going to work up on the Spine. I said, lovely. I said, and where will you sleep. He has not answered.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Market is on the Gantry until two. Bring your own light. And your own bag. And, honestly, your own opinion about the fish.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Is anyone else's beacon showing Cinder Step twice? Mine is showing it twice. There is one Cinder Step.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Fourteen years on this band and I still do not know who runs it. I just know it is always on.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Somebody's dog is on the Gantry roof again. It is fine. It lives up there now, apparently.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: First shift tonight. If I sound nervous it is because I am nervous. Be nice to me, lane.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Off shift, going down, going home, going to sleep for a very long time. Good luck to whoever has the Lantern run.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Tower maintenance, block four. We know about the lights. We have known about the lights since spring.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Does anybody actually live in Pale Terrace? I have flown past it every night this month and I have never seen a curtain move.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: A kid asked me today why the rain is warm. I did not have an answer. I still do not.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: If the person who found a courier bag at Marrow Landing is listening, there is a photograph in it that matters to somebody. Please.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Reminder to whoever is flying the Ribs at fifty metres. There are people under you. You cannot see them. They can definitely hear you.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Somebody is playing the understack out loud on Pike Deck and honestly, good.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: I have worked out that if I take Cinder Mile instead of the Spine Run I save four minutes and lose my mind. It is a trade.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: The lamps in the Lantern Quarter are on the wrong colour again. Everyone looks ill. Everyone looks like that anyway, but more so.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: Old Ferrand has gone. Just so you all know. He had that pad thirty years. Somebody put a light on for him.

chatter.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
chatter.text: That is me done. First run, delivered, nothing broken. I am going to talk about this for a week.
